positive_cases.query: Lint warning baseline and budget multi-language lint warnings baseline
turn an existing warning backlog into a measured, non-growing budget Inventory configured compilers, linters, warning-as-error gates, and suppression files.
Dead code and unused symbol removal multi-language dead-code unused reachability
remove unreachable code and unused symbols without deleting runtime-discovered behavior Combine compiler or linter diagnostics with call-site, export, reflection, plugin, and configuration searches.
Duplicated logic consolidation multi-language duplication refactor contracts
consolidate behaviorally equivalent logic while preserving each caller's contract Find structurally similar blocks and compare inputs, outputs, side effects, and error semantics.
Complexity and long-function reduction multi-language complexity control-flow refactor
reduce hard-to-review control flow without changing behavior Use configured complexity diagnostics and inspect nesting, early exits, state mutation, and mixed responsibilities.
Deterministic test and flake remediation multi-language tests flaky determinism
remove nondeterminism from a reproducibly flaky test Reproduce with repeated, shuffled, isolated, and parallel runs while recording seed and environment.
Test isolation and fixture hygiene multi-language tests fixtures isolation
eliminate order-dependent fixtures and leaked test state Run tests alone and in varied order while tracking global, database, filesystem, environment, and mock state.
Deprecated API migration multi-language deprecation compatibility migration
replace deprecated APIs using the repository's supported runtime versions Collect compiler and runtime deprecations and confirm the installed and minimum supported versions.
Configuration validation and default hygiene multi-language configuration validation defaults
make invalid configuration fail clearly and defaults behave consistently Trace configuration sources, precedence, parsing, coercion, defaults, and startup failure behavior.
Structured logging and cardinality hygiene multi-language logging observability cardinality
make logs structured, actionable, and bounded without exposing sensitive data Inventory free-form interpolation, inconsistent event names, high-cardinality fields, and duplicate error logs.
Feature flag and experiment cleanup multi-language feature-flags experiments dead-code
remove stale feature-flag branches after rollout state is proven Find flag definitions, readers, defaults, tests, analytics, rollout records, and operational ownership.
TODO, FIXME, and suppression debt multi-language todo fixme suppressions
turn stale annotations and diagnostic suppressions into owned, reviewable work Inventory TODO, FIXME, disabled-rule, ignore, pragma, and expected-failure annotations with history.
Time, date, timezone, and clock hygiene multi-language time timezone clock
make temporal logic explicit, testable, and timezone-safe Find direct wall-clock reads, naive timestamps, local-time assumptions, duration math, and implicit timezone conversion.
Serialization schema and versioning hygiene multi-language serialization schema versioning
make serialized contracts explicit and backward-compatible Inventory encoders, decoders, schema files, field aliases, defaults, and persisted payload versions.
Regular-expression correctness and complexity hygiene multi-language regex complexity parsing
make complex regular expressions bounded, readable, and behaviorally tested Find nested quantifiers, ambiguous alternation, catastrophic backtracking risk, and undocumented capture dependencies.
Unicode, locale, and normalization hygiene multi-language unicode locale normalization
make text comparison and normalization semantics intentional Trace case conversion, normalization, collation, length, slicing, identifier, and display operations.
Dependency manifest and lockfile hygiene multi-language dependencies lockfiles manifests

align declared, resolved, direct, optional, and unused dependencies without upgrading them Compare manifests, lockfiles, workspace definitions, imports, build plugins, scripts, and deployment packaging.
TypeScript strictness and escape-hatch debt javascript-typescript/npm typescript strict any

reduce unsafe any, ignore directives, assertions, and disabled strict checks incrementally Read the effective tsconfig graph and inventory any, unknown casts, non-null assertions, and ignore directives.
JavaScript promise, abort, and listener lifecycle javascript-typescript/npm javascript promises abortcontroller
close floating promises, lost failures, uncancelled work, and leaked event listeners Trace promise creation, awaiting, rejection ownership, AbortSignal propagation, and listener registration/removal.
JavaScript module cycles, side effects, and unused exports javascript-typescript/npm javascript modules cycles
make module initialization order and public exports predictable Build the import graph and inspect cycles, barrel files, side-effect imports, package exports, and unused symbols.
React hook, effect, and state lifecycle javascript-typescript/npm react hooks effects
remove stale closures, redundant state, and effect cleanup defects Inspect dependency arrays, derived state, effect ownership, subscriptions, async work, and Strict Mode behavior.
Node.js stream, emitter, and handle lifecycle javascript-typescript/npm nodejs streams eventemitter
prevent stream stalls, duplicate listeners, and handles that keep processes alive Trace stream backpressure, pipeline errors, listener counts, timers, sockets, and handle close ownership.
Python typing Any and ignore debt python/pypi python typing any
narrow Any, casts, and type-ignore suppressions at trusted boundaries Read the configured type checker and inventory explicit Any, implicit Any, casts, and ignore codes.
Python mutable-default, dataclass, and sentinel hygiene python/pypi python dataclasses mutable-defaults
remove shared mutable defaults and ambiguous sentinel values Find mutable parameter and field defaults, reused class state, and None overloaded as both data and absence.
Python exception, context, and resource lifecycle python/pypi python exceptions context-managers

preserve exception context and deterministically release files, locks, sessions, and generators Find broad catches, swallowed exceptions, raise-without-chaining, manual close paths, and generator cleanup gaps.
Python asyncio task cancellation and timeouts python/pypi python asyncio cancellation
eliminate orphaned tasks, swallowed cancellation, and unbounded awaits Trace create_task ownership, TaskGroup use, cancellation propagation, timeout boundaries, and blocking calls.
Python import, packaging, and module boundaries python/pypi python imports packaging
remove import cycles and make package exports and runtime discovery explicit Map imports, __init__ exports, entry points, namespace packages, import-time side effects, and optional extras.
Java compiler warning, deprecation, and suppression debt java/maven-gradle java javac deprecation
resolve javac warnings and narrow SuppressWarnings annotations Read Maven or Gradle compiler settings and inventory lint categories, deprecations, unchecked operations, and suppressions.
Java nullability, Optional, and boundary contracts java/maven-gradle java nullability optional
make null contracts explicit without misusing Optional in storage or fields Trace nullable inputs, dereferences, annotations, Optional creation, serialization, persistence, and framework injection.
Java AutoCloseable and resource lifecycle java/maven-gradle java autocloseable resources
close files, streams, clients, cursors, and scopes on every exit path Find AutoCloseable creation and trace ownership through returns, exceptions, wrappers, and asynchronous work.
Java executor, Future, and ThreadLocal lifecycle java/maven-gradle java executor future
bound background work and clean executor and thread-local state Trace executor creation, queue bounds, Future observation, cancellation, shutdown, and ThreadLocal removal.
Kotlin compiler, Detekt, and suppression debt kotlin/gradle kotlin detekt compiler
resolve Kotlin diagnostics and narrow file or declaration suppressions Read compiler, Gradle, and Detekt settings and inventory warnings, baseline entries, and Suppress annotations.
Kotlin coroutine scope, cancellation, and Flow lifecycle kotlin/gradle kotlin coroutines flow

replace orphaned coroutines and uncollected or multiply collected flows with owned lifecycles Trace scope creation, Job parentage, dispatcher use, cancellation, exception handlers, and Flow collection.
Kotlin nullability, platform types, and immutability kotlin/gradle kotlin nullability platform-types

contain Java platform types and remove unsafe assertions and unintended mutation Find platform types, double-bang assertions, unsafe casts, mutable collection exposure, and data-class copy assumptions.
.NET nullable and analyzer suppression debt dotnet/nuget dotnet nullable analyzers

resolve nullable and analyzer warnings without null-forgiving or pragma expansion Read project, Directory.Build, and editorconfig settings and inventory nullable warnings, pragmas, and global suppressions.
.NET async cancellation and fire-and-forget lifecycle dotnet/nuget dotnet async cancellationtoken
propagate CancellationToken and observe every Task failure Trace Task creation, awaiting, token flow, timeout ownership, async void, and background service lifetime.
.NET disposable and async-disposable lifecycle dotnet/nuget dotnet idisposable iasyncdisposable

dispose synchronous and asynchronous resources exactly once after their final use Trace IDisposable and IAsyncDisposable ownership across factories, DI scopes, returns, exceptions, and unawaited tasks.
.NET LINQ enumeration and EF query boundaries dotnet/nuget dotnet linq entity-framework

avoid repeated enumeration, client evaluation, N+1 loading, and leaked query lifetimes Trace IQueryable versus IEnumerable transitions, materialization points, repeated enumeration, includes, and per-row queries.
Go vet and lint suppression debt go/modules go vet lint
resolve Go diagnostics and narrow nolint directives Read module, workspace, build-tag, vet, and configured linter settings and inventory nolint directives.
Go error wrapping and sentinel contracts go/modules go errors wrapping
preserve error identity and context without string matching or duplicate logging Trace error creation, wrapping, comparison, type assertion, logging, and translation at API boundaries.
Go goroutine, context, cancellation, and leak hygiene go/modules go goroutines context
give every goroutine and context a bounded owner and shutdown path Trace goroutine starts, context derivation, cancel calls, channel exits, timers, and WaitGroup or errgroup joins.
Go channel, lock, and shared-state hygiene go/modules go channels mutex
remove channel ownership ambiguity, lock misuse, and data races Map shared variables, lock scopes, channel creators, senders, closers, and blocking operations.
Rust Clippy lint baseline and allow debt rust/cargo rust clippy lints
resolve correctness and suspicious lints and narrow allow attributes Read Cargo lint tables, clippy configuration, MSRV, feature matrix, and allow or expect attributes.
Rust panic, unwrap, expect, and error boundaries rust/cargo rust panic unwrap
keep recoverable failures out of panic paths while preserving invariants Inventory unwrap, expect, panic, indexing, assertions, and error conversion by binary, library, test, and invariant boundary.
Rust unsafe block and safety-invariant hygiene rust/cargo rust unsafe invariants
minimize unsafe scope and make every safety invariant locally reviewable Inventory unsafe blocks, functions, impls, FFI boundaries, raw pointer lifetimes, aliasing, and layout assumptions.
Rust async cancellation, lock, and task lifecycle rust/cargo rust async cancellation
avoid detached tasks, locks across await, and cancellation-unsafe partial operations Trace spawn ownership, JoinHandle observation, select cancellation points, lock guards, and shutdown signals.
C and C++ compiler warning and suppression debt c-cpp/cmake c cpp compiler
resolve portable compiler diagnostics without blanket flags or pragmas Read build flags per compiler, target, configuration, and generated-code boundary and inventory pragmas.
C and C++ ownership, RAII, and resource lifecycle c-cpp/cmake c cpp ownership
make memory, file, socket, lock, and handle ownership explicit Trace allocation, acquisition, transfer, release, error jumps, destructors, and raw owning pointers.
C and C++ bounds, integer, and undefined-behavior hygiene c-cpp/cmake c cpp bounds

remove unchecked bounds, lossy arithmetic, lifetime, and undefined-behavior hazards Trace lengths, offsets, signedness, narrowing, pointer arithmetic, shifts, overflow assumptions, and object lifetimes.
C and C++ atomic, lock, and thread lifecycle c-cpp/cmake c cpp atomics
remove data races, lock-order hazards, and detached thread lifetimes Map shared mutable state, synchronization, memory order, lock order, callbacks under locks, and thread join ownership.
C and C++ const, span, view, and lifetime hygiene c-cpp/cmake c cpp const
make mutation and non-owning view lifetimes explicit Find raw pointer-length pairs, dangling views, temporaries bound to references, unnecessary mutation, and const casts.
Ruby RuboCop baseline and disable debt ruby/bundler ruby rubocop lint
resolve RuboCop offenses and narrow disabled cops without broad rewrites Read inherited RuboCop configuration, target Ruby version, generated paths, TODO baselines, and inline disables.
Rails query, transaction, and callback hygiene ruby/bundler ruby rails active-record

make Active Record query count, transaction scope, and callback side effects explicit Trace relation materialization, associations, per-row queries, transactions, callbacks, validations, and after-commit work.
PHP strict types, static analysis, and suppression debt php/composer php strict-types static-analysis

narrow mixed values and static-analysis suppressions without breaking framework boundaries Read PHP version, analyzer configuration and baseline, strict_types use, docblocks, mixed values, and ignores.
PHP exception, stream, and resource lifecycle php/composer php exceptions streams
close resources and preserve failure context across PHP request and worker paths Trace fopen and stream resources, database handles, locks, temporary files, catches, finally blocks, and worker reuse.
Swift warning, deprecation, and force-unwrap debt swift/swiftpm swift warnings deprecation

resolve compiler warnings and unsafe optionals without obscuring invariants Read Swift language mode and deployment targets and inventory warnings, unavailable APIs, force unwraps, casts, and try-bang.
Swift actor, Sendable, and task lifecycle swift/swiftpm swift actors sendable
resolve isolation violations, unsafe sharing, and unowned tasks Trace actor isolation, Sendable crossings, detached tasks, task groups, cancellation, and main-actor work.
Dart analyzer, null-safety, and ignore debt dart/pub dart analyzer null-safety

resolve analyzer diagnostics and remove unsafe null assertions and broad ignores Read analysis_options, SDK constraints, generated exclusions, ignore comments, dynamic values, casts, and bang assertions.
Flutter Future, stream, controller, and widget lifecycle dart/pub flutter futures streams

cancel subscriptions and dispose controllers and async work with the owning widget or service Trace subscriptions, timers, controllers, focus nodes, animations, futures, mounted checks, and dispose ordering.
ShellCheck quoting and word-splitting hygiene shell/posix shell shellcheck quoting
remove unintended expansion, globbing, and argument-boundary bugs Run the repository's ShellCheck dialect and trace variable, command, array, glob, here-document, and positional expansion.
Shell exit, pipeline, trap, and temporary-file lifecycle shell/posix shell exit-codes pipelines
propagate failures and clean temporary state on every signal and exit Trace pipeline status, subshells, command substitutions, conditional exceptions, traps, mktemp use, and cleanup ownership.
PowerShell ScriptAnalyzer and suppression debt powershell/modules powershell psscriptanalyzer lint
resolve PSScriptAnalyzer findings and narrow rule exclusions Read analyzer settings, target editions and versions, module manifests, suppressions, and compatibility rules.
PowerShell error, output, and resource lifecycle powershell/modules powershell errors pipeline

make terminating behavior, pipeline output, and disposable resources predictable Trace ErrorAction, preference variables, try-catch-finally, native exit codes, Write-Output leakage, streams, jobs, and runspaces.
SQL migration idempotence and rollback hygiene sql/database sql migrations rollback

make schema migrations ordered, restartable where required, and operationally reversible Inspect migration framework ordering, transactional DDL support, backfills, locks, defaults, and deploy sequencing.
SQL transaction, locking, and concurrency hygiene sql/database sql transactions locks
make transaction scope and concurrent update behavior explicit Trace transaction begin and end, isolation, lock order, retries, read-modify-write sequences, and external calls inside transactions.
SQL query plan, index, and N+1 hygiene sql/database sql query-plan indexes

remove proven query amplification and plan regressions using representative evidence Capture query count, parameterized SQL, representative EXPLAIN output, row estimates, scans, joins, and sort or spill behavior.
Terraform format, validation, and provider-lock hygiene terraform/providers terraform fmt validate
keep configuration canonical and provider resolution reproducible Inventory Terraform versions, required providers, lock hashes, modules, generated configuration, and workspace boundaries.
Terraform state-address and refactor safety terraform/providers terraform state moved-blocks
preserve resource identity through module and address refactors Map current and desired resource addresses, for_each keys, module paths, imports, moved blocks, and state ownership.
Dockerfile layer, cache, and build-context hygiene containers/oci docker dockerfile layers

make container builds reproducible, cache-efficient, and free of accidental context Inspect Dockerfile stage graph, context, dockerignore, copy order, package-manager caches, build arguments, and emitted artifacts.
Container signal, healthcheck, and shutdown hygiene containers/oci containers signals healthcheck
make PID 1 signal handling, readiness, health, and graceful shutdown correct Trace entrypoint form, PID 1, child processes, signal forwarding, grace periods, health commands, and open listeners.
Kubernetes schema, deprecation, and selector drift kubernetes/manifests kubernetes schema deprecation

remove deprecated fields and prevent selector and label contract drift Render manifests and inspect apiVersion, schema validation, immutable selectors, labels, patches, CRDs, and target cluster versions.
Kubernetes probe, resource, and rollout hygiene kubernetes/manifests kubernetes probes resources

make probes, resources, disruption, and rollout settings internally consistent Inspect startup, readiness, and liveness probes; requests and limits; termination grace; strategy; disruption budgets; and autoscaling inputs.
CI workflow timeout, concurrency, and cache hygiene ci/workflows ci workflows timeouts

bound CI jobs and prevent stale caches and duplicate workflow races Map triggers, permissions, job dependencies, timeouts, concurrency groups, cancellation, matrices, cache keys, and artifact lifetimes.
